articles.title: Mortgage Rates Decline for Second Consecutive Week
articles.summary: Mortgage rates remained relatively stable this week at 6.67%. Housing affordability has improved from a year ago, and recent increases in purchase and refinance applications suggest that borrowers continue to respond to even modest changes in mortgage rates.
